{White appears to have the initiative, but Black can win a pawn and keep an
advantage. What should you play?} 12... Nxd5 {[%wrong White is doing well. Try
again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Capture a pawn and open the
h4-d8 diagonal.]} (12... Nb4 $2 13. d6 {After Bxd6 and Bh7+ White will capture
on d6 with a dangerous attack. Try again and look for a way to win material.})
(12... Na5 $2 13. d6 {After Bxd6 and Bc2 White has a dangerous attack. Try
again and look for a way to win material.}) (12... Nb8 $2 13. Qe2 {White has a
dangerous attack. Try again and look for a way to win material.}) 13. Bxe7 {
Good choice! What should you capture next?} Ncxe7 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for the best capture.] [%hint Recapture and defend
your knight on d5.] Well played! Black has a clean extra pawn and good chances
to win the game.} (13... Nxc3 $2 14. Bxd8 {After Nxd1 and Bf6! White has good
compensation for the lost pawn. Try again and look for a better capture.}) (
13... Ndxe7 $2 14. Be4 {White's active pieces provide good compensation for
the lost pawn. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (13... Qxe7 $2 14.
Nxd5 {White wins a knight. Try again and look for a better capture.}) *

{How should Black take advantage of the weak dark squares on the white
queenside?} 6... Bc3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
good threat.] [%hint Target the a1-rook.]} (6... d5 $2 7. Bg2 {White prepares
to castle with a good position. The threat of dxc4 isn't significant because
it would make the g2-bishop very dangerous. Try again and look for a stronger
threat.}) (6... Ne4 $2 7. Bg2 {White prepares to castle with a good position.
Try to find a useful threat.}) (6... Bxd2+ $2 7. Bxd2 {White has a safe
position. Try again and look for a useful threat.}) 7. Rb1 {Good start! How
should Black make another pin?} Bb7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find a way to make a useful pin.] [%hint Pin the f3-knight.]} (7... c5 $2 8.
Bg2 {White prepares to castle with a good position. Try to find a way to make
a second pin.}) (7... Nc6 $2 8. Bg2 {White prepares to castle with a good
position. Try to find a way to make a second pin.}) (7... Ne4 $2 8. Bg2 {
White prepares to castle with a good position. Try to find a way to make a
second pin.}) 8. Bg2 {Good choice! How should Black win material?} Bxd4 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to win material.] 
[%hint Capture a pawn. Notice that the knight on f3 is pinned.] Great job! The
f3-knight is pinned, so White loses a pawn for no compensation.} (8... Bxf3 $2
9. Bxf3 {White recaptures and threatens the a8-rook. Try to find a stronger
capture.}) (8... Be4 $2 9. O-O {After Bxb1 and Nxb1 White has great
compensation for the sacrificed exchange. Try to find a better move to win
material.}) *

{White has played an aggressive pawn sacrifice on d5. How should you pin the
d5-pawn and start a dangerous attack?} 8. Nh4 {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try again and look for a way to pin the d5-pawn.] [%hint Pin the d5-pawn and
aim to bring a knight to f5.]} (8. Nd4 $2 Nc6 {It makes sense to aim for Nf5,
but there's a better way to do it that doesn't allow Black to offer a trade of
knights. How should you do it?}) (8. cxd5 $2 Bxd5 {Black recaptures without
getting doubled pawns. Try again and look for a way to pin the d5-pawn.}) (8.
Nc3 $2 dxc4 {Black wins a second pawn and White doesn't have enough
compensation. Try again and look for a good move with the other knight.}) (8.
Ne5 $2 Nc6 {There's a better square for the knight. Try to find a way for it
to reach the critical f5-square.}) (8. Nfd2 $2 c6 {There's a better square for
the knight. Try to find a way for it to reach the critical f5-square.}) (8. Ne1
$2 c6 {There's a more active square for the knight. Try to find it.}) 8... c6 {
Great start! How can you force Black to accept doubled pawns?} 9. cxd5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Trade on d5 to avoid losing another pawn.]} (9. Nf5 $2 dxc4 {Black wins a
second pawn. Try to prepare the useful Nf5 move with a good capture.}) (9. Qc2
$2 dxc4 {Black is ready to meet Qxc4 with d7-d5 and White has minimal
compensation for the lost pawn. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (9.
Nd2 $2 dxc4 {Black is ready to meet Nxc4 with d7-d5 and White has minimal
compensation for the lost pawn. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (9.
Na3 $2 dxc4 {Black is ready to meet Nxc4 with d7-d5 and White has minimal
compensation for the lost pawn. Try again and look for a good capture.}) 9...
Nxd5 {Good choice! How should you save your h4-knight?} 10. Nf5 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try to find the best square for your h4-knight.] 
[%hint Bring your knight to the aggressive f5-square.] Well played! The
f5-knight is a great attacking piece and Black has difficulty finishing
development. White has good compensation for the sacrificed pawn.} (10. Bxd5 $2
cxd5 {Black has the bishop pair and an extra pawn. Try again and look for a
strong knight move.}) (10. e4 $2 Bxh4 {Black is doing well. Try again and look
for a good knight move.}) (10. Nc3 $2 Nxc3 {After a trade on c3 Black will
play Bxh4 next and White is in trouble. Try again and look for a good move
with the other knight.}) (10. Nf3 $2 Nf6 {Black has a safe extra pawn. Try
again and look for a better knight move.}) *

center with a piece.] [%hint Offer a trade of knights in the center.]} (7... d5

place on e4.}) 8. Bd2 {Good choice! How should you support your knight?} f5 {

advantage. Try again and look for a good way to support your knight on e4.}) (

Try again and look for a good way to support your knight on e4.}) *
